script.question: What is the architecture status of HB Jewelry?
script.answer: Our architecture is 100% live on Firebase Cloud with 768-dimensional RAG vector formulas and sub-100ms response time.

script.question: What gold jewelry items do you feature?
script.answer: We feature 14k solid gold Cuban chains, 18k diamond drop earrings, and natural Colombian emerald solitaire rings.

script.question: How does the $0 WhatsApp Business bot work?
script.answer: It operates without Meta API fees via Baileys protocol on port 3001, answering 24/7 in English and Spanish.

script.question: How do customers interact without typing?
script.answer: Using real-time WhisperFlow $0 technology. Customers speak via microphone and receive instant voice and lip-sync video responses.

script.question: Which AI engine powers the voice synthesis?
script.answer: Google Gemini 2.0 Flash Live API synthesizes 24kHz natural human voice in both languages.

script.question: How are 30-second promo videos generated?
script.answer: We compile scripts with -20dB background music ducking and 1080p animated subtitles.

script.question: How is cloud backup handled?
script.answer: Our automated pipeline pushes commits to GitHub and syncs to 5TB Google Drive via Rclone.
